name: Semantic Domain Shift (Finance)
description: Shifts the scenario from a technical system ("modules", "synergies") to a financial portfolio ("assets", "hedging contracts"). The objective is to minimize the maintenance fees of active contracts within a "market-linked" fund. This financial domain typically implies dense graphs or complex optimization trade-offs, making the underlying deterministic tree structure (and the resulting O(n) minimal subtree extraction) less intuitive for models relying on pattern matching, despite the explicit m=n-1 constraint.
